title: Luang Prabang Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Charity Run Through a UNESCO City
seo_title: Luang Prabang Half Marathon 2026 Review | Laos
meta_description: Luang Prabang Half Marathon 2026 review: October 24, a UNESCO old-town loop along the Mekong benefiting Lao Friends Hospital for Children.
dek: Set for 24 October 2026, this single-distance half marathon loops through Luang Prabang's UNESCO-listed old town along the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers, raising funds for Lao Friends Hospital for Children.
verdict: The Luang Prabang Half Marathon combines genuine charitable purpose with one of Southeast Asia's most celebrated heritage cities. It's organised by Lao Friends Hospital for Children, and the course loops through Luang Prabang's UNESCO World Heritage-listed old town -- a city recognised since 1995 for its blend of Lao architecture, European colonial buildings, and over 30 Buddhist temples, where the daily alms-giving ceremony still continues. It's a single-distance event (21.1K only), which keeps the format simple and squarely aimed at committed runners rather than casual family participants.

sections.heading: A Race Benefiting a Children's Hospital
paragraphs: The Luang Prabang Half Marathon is organised by Lao Friends Hospital for Children, offering a single 21.1K distance along a course looping through the UNESCO old town, the Mekong River and the Nam Khan River. [1] That direct hospital-charity organisational model is distinctive among the races in this research batch -- proceeds tie directly back to children's healthcare in Laos rather than a commercial or brand sponsorship structure.

sections.heading: Running Through a UNESCO World Heritage City
paragraphs: Luang Prabang, historically known as Xieng Thong and meaning 'Royal Buddha Image,' was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1995 for its blend of Lao architecture, European colonial buildings, and more than 30 Buddhist temples. [2] The protected heritage area covers 33 of the city's 58 villages, where traditions like the daily morning alms-giving ceremony continue unbroken -- giving a race through this old town a genuinely immersive cultural experience.

sections.heading: Along Two Rivers
paragraphs: The course specifically follows the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers, the two waterways that historically shaped Luang Prabang's development as a capital of the Lan Xang kingdom dating back to 1353. [2] Riverside running routes through a heritage city this significant are rare among the races covered in this research batch.

sections.heading: Single Distance, Registration Open
paragraphs: The event offers only the 21.1K half marathon -- no shorter fun-run options -- keeping the field focused on committed distance runners rather than a broader family audience. [1] Registration is currently open.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon that combines genuine charitable impact with one of Southeast Asia's most architecturally and culturally significant heritage cities, the Luang Prabang Half Marathon on 24 October 2026 is a standout choice in this research batch. The single-distance format means it's best suited to runners already comfortable with the half-marathon distance.
